answers.answer: Use Jefferson's audited consolidated enterprise: Thomas Jefferson University education and research, care delivery, insurance, and LVHN results from 2024-08-01 (11 months in FY2025). Jefferson Health is a brand, not the same legal entity as Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc. Selected scope/identifier: enterprise_fy2025 — Audited consolidated enterprise Caveats: This is not a hospital-only perimeter. Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc. is an individual hospital filer, not the Jefferson enterprise.

Penn Medicine means neither UPHS alone nor the whole University. Its governance umbrella includes UPHS and the Perelman School of Medicine. For financial analysis, separately choose UPHS health-system component or the audited consolidated University. Selected scope/identifier: penn_medicine_governance_2025 — Penn Medicine governance umbrella Caveats: Penn Medicine is a brand and governance scope, not a legal entity or standalone financial consolidation.

Use the audited consolidated UPMC enterprise: Health Services, Insurance Services, and UPMC subsidiaries and controlled activities. Exclude the University of Pittsburgh. Selected scope/identifier: upmc_consolidated_cy2025 — Audited consolidated UPMC enterprise Caveats: This is a provider-insurer perimeter, with intercompany accounts and transactions eliminated. The University of Pittsburgh is academically affiliated but is not consolidated into UPMC.

Use EIN 23-2379751 for the 2023 Form 990 request, selecting the legal filer Health Partners Plans, Inc. Selected scope/identifier: Health Partners Plans, Inc. — EIN 23-2379751; tax period 2023 Caveats: Jefferson Health Plans is a marketing/reporting name; the broader insurance component includes related entities not fully inventoried in the fixture.

Use CCN 390111. Treat HUP as a facility operated by The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania, not as a separate Penn Medicine enterprise. Selected scope/identifier: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania — CCN 390111; operator EIN 23-1352685 Caveats: The facility/operator record does not define the Penn Medicine or UPHS enterprise perimeter.

Do not assign one EIN from the brand name alone. Specify the insurance product, policy issuer, or licensed company. Selected scope/identifier: Clarification required — no universal UPMC Health Plan EIN Caveats: UPMC Health Plan is a marketing name spanning multiple legal entities. The fixture does not contain a complete statutory entity inventory.

No. LVHN was not part of Jefferson as of 2024-07-31; the documented entry date is 2024-08-01. Selected scope/identifier: LVHN — not in perimeter on 2024-07-31; entry date 2024-08-01 Caveats: The fixture preserves LVHN as a historical node after its later merger into Jefferson Health Corporation.

No. Doylestown Health was not part of UPHS as of 2025-03-31; it joined on 2025-04-01. Selected scope/identifier: Doylestown Health — not in UPHS on 2025-03-31; entry date 2025-04-01 Caveats: Doylestown Hospital's facility CCN is 390203, but its exact EIN is unresolved in this fixture.

Use EIN 25-1423657 for UPMC's parent-organization FY2023 Form 990 request. Selected scope/identifier: UPMC parent organization — EIN 25-1423657; tax period 2023 Caveats: The fixture's exact-EIN evidence is UPMC's official FY2022 filing; continuity for FY2023 was not independently reverified. This is the parent EIN, not the UPMC Group return EIN or a hospital EIN.

Use operator EIN 23-2829095 and facility CCN 390174. Selected scope/identifier: Thomas Jefferson University Hospitals, Inc. — EIN 23-2829095; Thomas Jefferson University Hospital — CCN 390174 Caveats: This is an individual hospital legal/operator and facility record, not the Jefferson enterprise.

Penn Medicine has no standalone universal EIN. Specify the legal filer or reporting perimeter; if you mean The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania, its EIN is 23-1352685. Selected scope/identifier: Clarification required — no universal Penn Medicine EIN Caveats: The University's EIN does not by itself define UPHS, Penn Medicine governance, or a facility perimeter.

They are distinct campuses represented by a combined filer/provider record, not literally one campus. For the combined record, use EIN 25-0965480 and CCN 390164. Selected scope/identifier: UPMC Presbyterian Shadyside combined record — EIN 25-0965480; CCN 390164 Caveats: The exact identifier evidence is dated to FY ended 2022-06-30; current continuity was not reverified. The combined-filer EIN, UPMC Group return EIN, CMS CCN, and campus identities are not interchangeable.
